name: Residual-NeRF
definition: A method to improve depth perception and training speed for transparent objects by leveraging a static scene prior. It trains a background NeRF on the scene without objects, then trains a residual NeRF and a Mixnet to learn the changes caused by the transparent object.
summary: Residual-NeRF improves depth perception for transparent objects by learning to mix a static background NeRF with a residual NeRF via a Mixnet, reducing noise and holes without requiring pre-defined spatial areas.
